note: External-WASM candidate built but failed startup because the original decoder expression had a .buffer suffix; replacing only the decoder left the new initializer object followed by .buffer (undefined). The browser then fell through to the loader default deleted URL. Fixed by replacing the complete input expression, with a regression test. Public-base URL resolution was also made explicit for CommonJS compatibility.
